summary: Brera Holdings PLC, now operating as Solmate Infrastructure (NASDAQ: SLMT), filed a Form 6-K disclosing the appointment of Scott Buchanan as Chief Financial Officer effective October 1, 2026, following board action on September 23, 2026. Buchanan most recently served as CEO of Bitcoin Depot through its May 2026 Chapter 11 wind-down. No compensation, severance, or transition terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report on Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a Form 8-K Item 5.02 officer appointment, with no transactional mechanics or regulatory clock. Watch for subsequent disclosure on compensation terms and any strategic shift in the crypto-infrastructure business.
